visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a medium build, wearing a black t-shirt, a black baseball cap, and a prominent yellow and black striped towel around his neck, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically with both hands toward the camera while standing in front of a white whiteboard with some handwritten text. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style text boxes appear at the bottom and center of the frame. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as the man begins writing on the whiteboard with a blue marker. He writes the word 'Bad' in large letters and then the Chinese characters '背的' underneath it. He uses his hands to point at the text while maintaining an expressive, comedic facial expression with wide eyes and an open mouth. (3) The scene shifts to the man demonstrating a pun. He uses his right hand to grip his left arm as if it were broken, leaning over in a mock painful stance. The whiteboard remains in the background, now showing more detailed sentences. Large, purple variety text blocks with '??????' and '手受傷' flash on the screen to emphasize the punchline. (4) In a dynamic movement, the man physically lifts the large whiteboard and flips it upside down to reveal a hidden pun. He points excitedly at the inverted text while leaning toward the camera. The background lighting is consistent and bright, highlighting his energetic facial movements and the large blue characters written on the board. (5) The man reaches down and picks up a black rubber slipper, holding it up to the camera with a wide grin. He gestures toward the slipper while finishing his joke. The video ends with him laughing and looking directly at the viewer, with variety text '是我的鞋音啦' appearing in red and white on the screen.
